description: Utility functions for the OpenBB Core application, including data conversions between DataModels and pandas DataFrames/Series, and auxiliary functions for data handling and system settings.

methods.name: "DataFrame" basemodel_to_df( data: Union[List[Data], Data], index: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Converts a list or single instance of Data models to a pandas DataFrame, handling multiindex and date conversions.

methods.name: List[Data] df_to_basemodel( df: Union["DataFrame", "Series"], index: bool = False )
methods.description: Converts pandas DataFrame or Series to a list of Data models, handling multiindex and date formatting.

methods.name: List[Data] list_to_basemodel(data_list: List)
methods.description: Converts a list of dictionaries, Data models, or pandas objects to a list of Data models.

methods.name: Data dict_to_basemodel(data_dict: Dict)
methods.description: Creates a Data model instance from a dictionary, raising a validation error if invalid.

methods.name: List[Data] ndarray_to_basemodel(array: "ndarray")
methods.description: Converts a 2D numpy array to a list of Data models.

methods.name: Union[Data,List[Data]] convert_to_basemodel(data)
methods.description: Dispatches to appropriate conversion function based on input type.

methods.name: "Series" get_target_column(df: "DataFrame", target: str)
methods.description: Extracts a specific target column from a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: "DataFrame" get_target_columns(df: "DataFrame", target_columns: List[str])
methods.description: Extracts multiple target columns from a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: str get_user_cache_directory()
methods.description: Retrieves the user cache directory setting from system settings or preferences.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_single_item( value: Optional[str], message: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Ensures that a string contains only a single item, raises an error otherwise.

ctags.name: basemodel_to_df
ctags.signature: ( data: Union[List[Data], Data], index: Optional[str] = None, )
